findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Soda nozzle was observed to contain an accumulation of mold.  Discussed with PIC, corrected on site.  Ensure soda nozzle and gun is cleaned daily to prevent accumulation of mold and debris.

4-602.11: (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Chlorine test strips are available, but the facility uses quaternary ammonium as a sanitizer.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the proper test strips are available to test the concentration of sanitizer.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The trim attaching the wall and mop sink has an accumulation of mold.  Discussed with PIC, adding caulk along the seams and trim will make the area non absorbent and easily cleanable.  Ensure the trim is sealed.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.
